## `/review` specialists

Specialist checklists installed: api-contract data-migration maintainability performance red-team security simplification testing 
Design specialist: checklist-driven (`review/design-checklist.md`).
Force flags: --security --performance --testing --maintainability --data-migration --api-contract --design --simplification --all-specialists 
Always-on threshold: every review with 50+ changed lines
Small-diff skip: DIFF_LINES < 50 → all specialists skipped
Security (backend scope): DIFF_LINES > 100
Simplification: DIFF_LINES > 100 (advisory only)
Red team: Only if DIFF_LINES > 200 OR any specialist produced a CRITICAL finding.
Adaptive gating: conditional specialists with 0 findings in 10+ dispatches are auto-gated off; NEVER_GATE specialists (security, data-migration) always run.

## `/autoplan` phase order

Phases MUST execute in strict order: CEO → Design (if UI scope) → DX (if developer-facing scope) → Eng.


## Plan-review scope gates

- `/plan-eng-review`: scope gate (auto-resolves when the target is named in args or in plan mode)
- `/plan-design-review`: scope gate (auto-resolves when the target is named in args or in plan mode)
- `/plan-ceo-review`: no scope gate
- `/plan-devex-review`: no scope gate
- `/autoplan`: no gate question — the plan under review is already the target
